grid._note: Re bounds (6800-29500) match the velocity range (1.2-5.2 m/s) Ebert & Panchal's Fig. 2 data was actually regressed over, given this benchmark's D_h/rho/mu; Re bounds also lie within Blasius/Darcy smooth-pipe turbulent validity (about 4e3-1e5). Tb (bulk, kelvin) and T_w below are chosen so film temperature T_f=(Tb+T_w)/2 falls inside Ebert-Panchal's documented fit window: Fig. 2 of @wilson2017twenty plots the correlation over a film-temperature range of 200-500 degC (473-773 K).

physical._units: D_h m; rho kg/m^3; mu Pa s; T_w K. T_w > T_b,max (500 K) as required; T_f then ranges 485-525 K, inside the correlation's 473-773 K fitted window.

friction._note: Smooth-tube turbulent Darcy friction factor f_D = 0.3164 Re^-0.25 (Blasius).

simulator._units: A_ind, A_rem in d^-1; E_ind, E_dep in J/mol; A_dep in native-resistance-units/day; z_c, p, q dimensionless; T_ref K; Re_ref dimensionless; tau_ref Pa; R_g J/(mol K).
simulator._provenance: Selected only to satisfy the preregistered induction-coverage fraction and the positive-range gate below, independently of Ebert-Panchal coefficients and of either model's outcome. Frozen before any model training.

ebert_panchal.variant: Ebert and Panchal (1997), Equation (1), as documented by Wilson, Ishiyama & Polley (2017)
ebert_panchal.equation: Fig. 2 caption (loci fitted to Ebert and Panchal 1997 / Scarborough et al. 1979 data): dRf/dt = a1 Re^b1 exp(-Ea/(R Tf)) - c1 tau_w

transcription_check.method: visual reading of two independently rendered page images (300 dpi and 600 dpi PyMuPDF renders of the open-access conference PDF), not pdftotext
transcription_check.verified_against: Fig. 2 caption text, page 2 of the Enfield 2015 conference PDF (printed page 844 of the original proceedings volume): 'Loci plotted for parameters a1 = 30.2x10^6 K m2/kW h; b1 = -0.88, c1 = 1.45x10^-4 m2 K m2/kW Pa h and Ea = 68 kJ/mol.'

ebert_panchal._note: a1's unit denominator carries an implicit per-hour rate, so the fixed physics baseline integrates over H_hours = 30 d * 24 h/d = 720 h, not H_days, to stay in the units the source's own coefficients were regressed in.

models._note: Both arms use MLPRegressor with the identical 2-input architecture (Re, Tb normalized) at every trial; the black-box output is Rf directly and the hybrid output is the learned discrepancy, so trainable-parameter counts are equal by construction (ratio 0%), not merely matched within 10%. Every trial applies the same hidden_layer_sizes/learning_rate_init/alpha combination to both arms.

random_seed_policy._note: Per-repetition seeds are derived deterministically from master_seed and the repetition index; both arms in a repetition share the same split/noise/init seed stream, differing only in which target they are fit to.
